caption:
Global Metadata: A haunting Scandinavian folk piece, 72 BPM, atmospheric and rooted. Centered on the hardanger fiddle (a Norwegian violin with sympathetic under-strings) with its bright, resonant, slightly reedy tone, joined by a deep sustained drone and a soft wooden percussion. The fiddle plays a modal, melancholic melody over the drone, building in a slow meditative arc, then easing to a quiet ending. Production profile: close, atmospheric folk recording, resonant hardanger fiddle tone, warm drone, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: No vocals at all. Purely instrumental. Do not add any singing, humming, or voice.

Arrangement: Intro, a deep sustained drone establishes a rooted, open mood. Section one, the hardanger fiddle enters with a modal, melancholic melody. Section two, the fiddle melody builds slowly over the drone and soft percussion. Section three, a meditative peak. Outro, eases to a quiet ending and a soft fade.
